fields.description:
Observe the result of an applied repair before the repair loop reports a terminal state, so a budget breach never escalates on a checks status that predates the repair.

`_ci_and_repair` in `services/orchestration/temporal_workflows/draft_pull_request.py` drives the repair loop. Each iteration asks `_repair` for a fix, evaluates `_budget_breach`, and leaves the loop when the budget is spent. The outcome it returns feeds the caller, which treats `CI_FAILED` as grounds to alert a human through `_alert_human_intervention` and wait for a decision, and treats `CI_PASSED` as grounds to run the reviews, the policy evaluation, and the pull request.

The loop must not report a checks status that predates the last applied repair. When a repair has been applied, the platform has already paid for it and written it to the branch, so the checks must run again before the loop decides what to report. When no repair was applied, nothing changed on the branch and no further checks run is warranted.

Stopping once the budget is spent stays correct, and the `REPAIR_BUDGET_EXCEEDED` audit event still records the breach in every case. What changes is the reported outcome. A run whose last applied repair leaves the checks failing reports the budget reason and escalates. A run whose last applied repair turns the checks green reports the passing status and continues, because the verified work is already paid for and waking a human to confirm what the checks proved adds nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] An applied repair is verified by a further checks run before the budget ends the loop, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_repair_budget.py -k applied_repair_is_verified_before_the_budget_terminates_the_run`
- [ ] A run whose final repair fixes the checks reports the repaired status with no terminal reason, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_repair_budget.py -k budget_breach_after_a_successful_repair_reports_the_repaired_status`
- [ ] A run whose final repair leaves the checks failing still reports the budget reason, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_repair_budget.py -k budget_breach_after_a_failed_repair_still_reports_the_budget_reason`
- [ ] A budget breach on an unapplied repair ends the loop without a further checks run, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_repair_budget.py -k budget_breach_without_an_applied_repair_runs_no_further_checks`

## Testing
Run each acceptance criterion selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing the ticket.
